Gaussian validation page — local experiment

Pipeline: DA3-BASE depth prediction → BLUNT depth unprojection → Gaussian PLY → Spark.
No SHARP model, no DA3 learned Gaussian head, no VGGT checkpoint, no inpainting.
The output is a depth-derived 3D Gaussian representation of the visible surface,
not a complete reconstruction of the room or occluded objects.

BLUNT: Copyright (c) 2026 StorySplat. MIT.
https://github.com/SonnyC56/blunt
Full license: vendor/BLUNT-LICENSE.txt

Depth Anything 3 code and DA3-BASE weights: Apache License 2.0.
https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/Depth-Anything-3
https://huggingface.co/depth-anything/DA3-BASE
Full license: vendor/DA3-LICENSE.txt
Only the explicitly Apache-licensed BASE model is used.

Spark 2.4.0: MIT, license in vendor/SPARK-LICENSE.txt
https://github.com/sparkjsdev/spark
Three.js: existing project runtime; MIT.
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js

The reference photograph was supplied by the user for this private experiment.
Model/code licenses do not confer copyright in the supplied photograph.

Edge refinement uses existing SAM 2.1 segmentation masks from the earlier project stage (no new model inference). Mask hashes are recorded in scene.json. SAM attribution/license is retained at ../assets/objects/SAM2-LICENSE.txt. No hidden-background completion is performed.
